The whitepaper drops 'new or changed' ('its requirement is that EVERY capability be reachable...') and adds the flat assertion 'there is no UI-only capability surface' - a claim the ADR itself declines to make, and which the whitepaper's own section 3.5 contradicts by naming /fragments/results and the workflow-executions LIST fragment.
